connector.name: Gency MCP
connector.registryDescription: Gency AI product image generation - MCP server for Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gency-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.gency. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GENCY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth client ID override. Defaults to the built-in official client, so most users never set this.

env.name: GENCY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OAuth client secret, only needed for confidential clients.

env.name: GENCY_OAUTH_API_BASE
env.description: OAuth provider base URL. Defaults to GENCY_API_URL.

env.name: GENCY_MCP_ALLOWED_CLIENT_IDS
env.description: serve-http only: OAuth client IDs whose tokens this server accepts (space or comma separated). Empty accepts any client.

env.name: GENCY_MCP_UPLOAD_SECRET
env.description: serve-http only: HMAC key for signed upload handles. Only needed when running more than one instance, so a handle issued by one verifies on another.

env.name: GENCY_MCP_OAUTH_RESOURCE
env.description: RFC 8707 resource indicator to send on authorize/token/refresh requests. Opt-in until the Gency authorization server is confirmed to accept it.
